map.CTR（Click-Through Rate，点击率）是指广告点击量与展示量的比: CTR (Click-Through Rate) is the ratio of ad clicks to impressions and the core measure of how appealing an ad is. A high CTR means the creative and targeting are better matched.
map.例如：展示10,000次，获得200次点击，则 CTR = (200 ÷ 10,: For example with 10,000 impressions and 200 clicks, CTR = (200 / 10,000) × 100% = 2%.

map.在付费广告平台中，CTR是影响质量分的关键因素。高CTR通常意味着更低的CPC和: On paid ad platforms CTR is a key driver of quality score. A high CTR usually means a lower CPC and a better ad rank, creating a virtuous circle.
map.评估素材/标题吸引力，算点击占展示比。: Judge how appealing the creative and headline are by computing clicks as a share of impressions.
map.由 CTR 与花费反推 CPC、CPM、CPA。: Derive CPC, CPM and CPA from CTR and spend.
map.多素材 A/B 按 CTR 选最优。: A/B multiple creatives and pick the winner by CTR.
map.展示 100000、点击 3000 → CTR=3%；花费 6000 → CPM: Impressions 100000 and clicks 3000 gives CTR = 3%; spend 6000 gives CPM = 60 and CPC = 2; 100 conversions gives CPA = 60 CNY.
map.素材 A CTR=2%、素材 B CTR=4%，同样展示量 B 多一倍点击，应全: Creative A CTR = 2% and creative B CTR = 4%: with the same impressions B gets twice the clicks, so roll out B in full.

map.行业差异大：搜索广告常 3–5%，信息流 1–3%，超 5% 优秀。同行业同版位: It varies widely by industry: search ads usually 3-5%, feeds 1-3% and above 5% is excellent. Only comparisons within the same industry and placement mean anything.
